clips.title: 达美航空CEO：油价将“更持久地高企”
title_lines: 高端消费支撑需求，航司仍有提价空间

subtitles.en: You talk about the difficulties of this quarter as well as the resilience of the U.S. consumer.
subtitles.zh: 你谈到了本季度的困难，以及美国消费者的韧性。

subtitles.en: How much momentum is there under the U.S. consumer? Well, first of all, thank you for coming down. There's not just one consumer in our market place,
subtitles.zh: 美国消费者的动力有多强？首先，感谢你前来。我们的市场中不止一种消费者，

subtitles.en: but broadly speaking, I think the consumers doing well. Certainly the higher-end consumers doing very, very well. That's our consumer base. When you look at what's happening in the market,
subtitles.zh: 但总体而言，我认为消费者表现不错。高端消费者尤其出色。那是我们的客户群。当你观察市场动态，

subtitles.en: when you see what's happening in real estate, opportunities for that consumer to invest in themselves, invest in the experience economy, they may not be buying things as much, but they're investing in
subtitles.zh: 以及房地产领域，这些消费者有机会**自身、**体验经济，他们可能不再大量购物，而是**于

subtitles.en: things they care about for themselves or families or friends in the future. In this travel.
subtitles.zh: 他们关心的事物，为自己、家人或朋友，比如旅行。

subtitles.en: You also talk about the difficulty, and we have seen oil prices inflict a bit higher.
subtitles.zh: 你还提到了困难，我们看到油价有所上涨。

subtitles.en: How much room do you have to maneuver if this is a new normal or potentially $80 on Brent Crude is a new normal which we're just up against? I think we'll do just fine. We look at our business model,
subtitles.zh: 如果这是新常态，或者布伦特原油80美元成为新常态，你有多大回旋余地？我认为我们会做得很好。看看我们的商业模式，

subtitles.en: our business model is geared towards a higher-end consumer. Our consumer has the ability to sustain this level. In fact, we saw it in the quarter. We made at 9% operating margin with fuel prices
subtitles.zh: 我们的商业模式面向高端消费者。我们的客户有能力承受这一水平。事实上，本季度我们实现了9%的营业利润率，而燃油价格

subtitles.en: much higher than where they are in the existing landscape. I think oil is going to stay sticky
subtitles.zh: 远高于当前水平。我认为油价将保持粘性

subtitles.en: for longer. I'm not sure it's going to be in Crude though. I think the refined cost or crack spreads are where you're going to find it's going to take a lot longer for that to come down.
subtitles.zh: 更长时间。但我不确定是原油。我认为精炼成本或裂解价差需要更长时间才能下降。
